name: Surface Mount Depot
old_description: Our customers’ needs shape the evolution of our electronics manufacturing solutions. Combining our commitment to our customers with industry-diverse services and expertise is what makes SMD different. Experience why
about:
Surface Mount Depot, now operating as SMD, was founded in 1988 in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. The company began as a contract electronics manufacturer focused on printed circuit board assembly and has since expanded into a full-service provider for high-reliability applications.

SMD delivers a range of electronics manufacturing services including surface mount and through-hole PCB assembly, cable and wire harness assembly, electromechanical and box-build assembly, hand soldering, functional testing, and engineering support. The facility employs automated placement equipment, wave and selective wave soldering, and advanced inspection systems to handle projects from prototype through production.

The company serves industrial and high-reliability electronics customers, providing contract manufacturing for applications that demand consistent quality and traceability. Its client base includes organizations requiring ITAR-compliant production and long-term supply partnerships.

SMD differentiates itself through an ISO 9001 certification held for over two decades, ITAR compliance, and a commitment to personalized service that assigns the same point of contact throughout a project. The company emphasizes competitive pricing, on-time delivery, and a stable workforce with many employees remaining since inception.
built_on: Consistent point of contact for each project
